name: Oogawara Sakuya
source:
Daughter of the school principal. She looks like her mother and is a high class dominant type like her. 

Perhaps because of her rebellious attitude towards her mother, she behaves in a reckless manner at school and its events. However, she still maintains good grades.

Like her mother, she makes passes at anyone and everyone. This behavior even extends to her also looking down on men including her father. She considers them as nothing more than playthings to distract her from boredom.

[From [url=http://www.r18game.com/tougenkyo/gyaku/chara.html]official site[/url]]
